title: Soup on Saturday Night
setting: A warm kitchen with a high shelf of plates.

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar, a young boy with short curly hair and a blue t-shirt

sentences.en: It is a cold Saturday night in April.
sentences.zh: 这是四月一个寒冷的星期六晚上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A cozy kitchen at night, rain on the dark window.

sentences.en: Nina makes hot soup from her home country.
sentences.zh: 妮娜做了一道她家乡的热汤。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt stirs a pot of hot soup on the stove.

sentences.en: The plates are on a high shelf.
sentences.zh: 盘子放在高高的架子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Plates stand on a high kitchen shelf above Nina, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt's head.

sentences.en: Omar helps her get a few big plates.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔帮她拿下几个大盘子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short curly hair and a blue t-shirt stands on a stool and takes a few big plates from the high shelf.

sentences.en: He hands her the brown plates with care.
sentences.zh: 他小心地把棕色的盘子递给她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short curly hair and a blue t-shirt carefully hands brown plates to Nina, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt.

sentences.en: There is enough soup for everyone.
sentences.scene_prompt: A big pot full of soup next to several filled brown plates on the table.

sentences.en: Omar is excited and cannot stop smiling.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔很兴奋，一直笑个不停。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short curly hair and a blue t-shirt sits at the table with a plate of soup, smiling widely, Nina, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt beside him.
